author: Russell Brand
description:
ICE deportations have accelerated across the U.S., with large-scale removals, visible detentions at airports, and renewed use of federal enforcement powers following a clear electoral mandate to crack down on illegal immigration. We examine how these actions are being justified, what they’re meant to achieve, and where enforcement aimed at criminals risks spilling over into indiscriminate punishment, drawing comparisons to hardline crackdowns abroad and asking who ultimately pays the price for “order.”
